title: Add webapp template: vite.config.ts
description: Create the Vite configuration template for the React client. Must include the React plugin, @/* path alias pointing to src/, and Vitest test configuration with jsdom environment.
acceptanceCriteria: Vitest test config uses jsdom environment
Template file exists with path alias and vitest config

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/client/vite.config.ts with: import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; import path from 'path'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], resolve: { alias: { '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src') } }, test: { environment: 'jsdom', globals: true, setupFiles: './src/test/setup.ts' } })
Create src/templates/webapp/client/src/test/setup.ts with: `import '@testing-library/jest-dom'`. This sets up DOM matchers for Vitest.

steps.description: Verify the config is syntactically correct
steps.details: Open the template file and verify it is valid TypeScript. The __dirname usage requires the tsconfig to include 'types': ['vite/client'].

technicalNotes: In Vite, the test config is inlined into vite.config.ts — no separate vitest.config.ts needed
The @/* path alias must also be configured in tsconfig.app.json paths for TypeScript to resolve it
